name: Christian Anti-Communism Crusade

summary.text: The Christian Anti-Communism Crusade (CACC) was founded in Waterloo, Iowa, in 1953 by Australian physician Fred C. Schwarz and later moved to Long Beach, California. A 1991 Militarist Monitor profile says it received funds from the Schick razor company, Richfield Oil and the Lilly Endowment, and lists Pew Memorial Trust grants totalling $215,000 between 1969 and 1978.

openQuestions: Patrick Frawley (who controlled Schick and Technicolor) and Walter Knott are named as funders of Schwarz's rallies only in a tertiary summary; the Schick corporate money is in Militarist Monitor. Hubert Villeneuve's Teaching Anticommunism (2020) covers CACC funding in detail and was not opened. The Richfield Oil link rests on the single Militarist Monitor profile.
